repair.checks: Members OpenAvatar 0.1 does not define are dropped, at the top, in the body and in the face
Numbers outside their ranges are clamped to the nearest bound (SPEC 4)
Integer members are rounded
Short and lowercase colors become #RRGGBB; a malformed color is dropped
A body shape of an unknown type is empty, so the body becomes a sphere of radius 0.9
Unknown children are dropped; a combinator left with one child becomes a union; a subtract whose base is gone is empty
Unknown standard ids take their fallback or are dropped: an expression, a motion, a prop, an effect, an outfit, a material type, a face type
x- ids and extensions are kept for the app that knows them
A part whose shape is invalid is dropped and the rest renders
A repeated part id is renamed
A part attached to a part listed after it, or to no part, is attached to the body, so attachments never form a cycle
A part placed two ways keeps the first of position, at and direction
A material id that names nothing is reported; renderers draw the body material in its place
Lists over their limits are cut: parts beyond 32 and tags beyond 12
A document of a newer minor version is read as 0.1
A preview that is not a PNG or WebP data URI is dropped
A UTF-8 byte order mark before the JSON is ignored
Each code point of the id outside A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - becomes -, and a body that is not an object becomes a blob, so a sphere (SPEC B.1)
In idleMotions and tags an item equal to an earlier one is removed, and the first keeps its place; an unknown idle motion turns into nod first (SPEC B.2)
Lengths count code points, so a name of 70 emoji is cut to its first 64 and no emoji is split (SPEC B.1)
A repeated 32-character part id is renamed within 32 characters; a later part attached to that id hangs on the first part that had it (SPEC B.5)
A date-time that names no real instant is dropped; lowercase t and z and a leap second at 23:59:60 UTC are kept (SPEC B.2)
Over 16 materials, the ids that come first in code point order stay, whatever order the file lists them in (SPEC B.2)
